workarounds.symptom: [Bug] 决策模型协议 SystemOne 的 noul 类型请求未兼容标准格式
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(provider): support optional System One boolean criteria. Target files: astrbot/core/provider/entities.py, astrbot/core/provider/provider.py, astrbot/core/provider/sources/system_one_decision_source.py. The System One–compatible endpoint reported in #10920 requires both `true` and `false` in `noul.criteria`. AstrBot's connection test omits `criteria`, so the endpoint returns HTTP 400. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11062)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] openrouter 适配器非流式模式下丢失思考内容：reasoning_details 数组未解析（GLM-5.3-Flash 等受影响）
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve OpenRouter reasoning details in non-streaming replies. Target files: astrbot/core/provider/sources/openrouter_source.py. OpenRouter can return non-streaming reasoning in a `reasoning_details` array instead of the flat `message.reasoning` field. The adapter now reads the text and summary entries when the flat field is absent or empty. It keeps the provider order, skips encrypted and malformed entries, and preserves the existing flat-field and streaming behavior. (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/11168)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] DashScope TTS 无法调用 qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus 模型，返回 InvalidParameter: url error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: support Qwen-Audio-TTS in DashScope provider. Target files: astrbot/core/config/default.py, astrbot/core/provider/sources/dashscope_tts.py, dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en-US/features/config-metadata.json. - Route Qwen-Audio-TTS models through the existing `SpeechSynthesizer` implementation instead of `MultiModalConversation`. - Add an optional, instance-local WebSocket endpoint setting while preserving the SDK default when it is blank. - Add Chinese, Japanese, English, and Russian translations, regression coverage, ... (Ref: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/pull/10495)
